description: This file defines the class `Image_Graph_Fill_Gradient` which is part of the Image_Graph library. It implements a gradient fill style for images, supporting various gradient directions and connecting with other components via inheritance. It includes a constructor to set gradient parameters and a private method to generate the fill style configuration.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Fill_Gradient
classes.description: A class that provides gradient fill style options for image rendering, supporting multiple gradient directions and colors.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Fill_Gradient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the gradient fill with specified direction and start/end colors.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Returns the GD fill style array based on the current gradient direction and colors.
